title: Construction of a new automatic grading system for jaw bone mineral density level based on deep learning using cone beam computed tomography
summary: The study evaluates patient CT scans for classification of jaw-bone mineral-density levels. The result is limited to the evaluated data and grading task; clinical benefit and external generalization are not established.
ai_technology: A deep-learning system grades jaw-bone mineral density from cone-beam CT images.
